output.summary: Arts' 9-day median is mostly explained by SlotBook tickets routed to the P4 best-effort queue under RR-17 (70% of the gap). Most of the rest comes from Lindqvist's Tuesday/Thursday-only on-site cover, which also affects Education. Matched non-SlotBook tickets show no deprioritisation of Arts, and duplicate and trivial ticket rates are normal. The SlotBook acknowledgement template never told requesters about best-effort status. Whether ITS told Arts leadership about RR-17 is unestablished, because the records are silent and the accounts conflict. The best next step is a written support agreement for SlotBook with a corrected acknowledgement and matched reporting. Handing the desk budget to Arts, putting all Arts tickets on P4, or forcing a CampusBook migration now would be harmful or premature.
